figures.finding: LATGA's tariff, approved on 13 February 2024, pays the author of an original play 10% of the theatre's ticket income (or of the troupe's contract sum). No sum is set to be paid before the play is performed.

royalty.of: the theatre's ticket income or the troupe's contract sum

figures.applies: Lithuania; a play licensed through LATGA.
